messages:
anya: Quick QA from this morning's pricing heatmap — calc module has heavy hover but low click. link: https://redwood-internal/hm/499876. Thinking a tiny in-module nudge to capture intent (workshop vs snapshot).

carla: Paste the numbers pls?

anya: impressions 4.2k, calc CTR 1.6%, hover->click ~11:1, median hover 3.7s, FAQ top expand 23%. repeat hovers common.

jess: Hypothesis: curiosity + uncertainty. Proposal: show micro-modal after second hover >2.5s. Two variants: A) "Reserve a 30min pricing workshop" B) "Get a quick cost snapshot". Both 2-field forms.

analytics-bot: Will need events: rw_calc_hover, rw_calc_modal_shown, rw_calc_variant, rw_calc_submit. Also capture calc_session_id and utm.

sales-ops: Routing idea: if rw_calc_submit && (company_size >= 200 || utm includes "enterprise"), route to SDR queue "pricing-fast-track" with 24h SLA; else route to nurture. Tag lead with variant and calc_session_id.

carla: Add a 1-line FAQ anchor in the modal: "What impacts cost most?" -> anchors to FAQ. Also pre-fill email if logged-in.

jess: I'll implement GTM events and a 7-day A/B test. Dashboard metrics: modal_shown rate, submit rate, routed_to_sdr, contact_time.

anya: Action items: carla  modal copy + both CTAs by EOD. jess  GTM + events + dashboard by tomorrow. sales-ops  HubSpot workflow + SLA by tomorrow noon. analytics-bot  ensure payload includes calc_session_id and user_email when available.

carla: Copy draft (workshop): "See Redwood costs at your scale — 30-min workshop + live Q&A." CTA: "Reserve my spot". (snapshot): "Get a quick cost snapshot for your workload" CTA: "Get snapshot".

anya: Nice. Let's run this 7 days and reconvene with heatmap + funnel numbers. :rocket:
